summary: Added a gated diagnostic ranking of the largest DXVK host capture/commit-copy/render/xrEndFrame P95 stage and reconciled L2-PERF-001 to HMD evidence pending without changing runtime performance policy.
behavior_verified: Host dominant-stage ranking is emitted only when DxvkPerformanceEvidenceReady=true.
Ranking compares MaxP95Observed for CAPTURE, COMMIT_COPY, RENDER and XR_END_FRAME.
The synthetic hosted PERFORMANCE fixture selects XR_END_FRAME at 7.0 ms.
When performance evidence is incomplete the dominant-stage field remains empty and P95 remains null.
L2-PERF-001 is NEED_HMD_TEST; automated evidence must not remove the intentional F30 hold-copy pair.
scope: Analyzer/test/queue only; no renderer, DXVK provider, DirectGPU synchronization, hold CopyResource count, wait/Flush policy, OpenXR submission, cadence or draw behavior changed.
blocker: No runtime optimization target is authorized until exact-build Quest3/VDXR PERFORMANCE evidence satisfies DxvkPerformanceEvidenceReady=true.
next_action: Run exact-build Quest3/VDXR DXVK PERFORMANCE. Use DxvkHostDominantBudgetStage/P95 together with producer fence/backpressure counters; change the intentional hold-copy pair only if measured commit/copy cost is material.
